description: This file declares the class DobbySpecGenerator, which is responsible for generating runtime specifications in JSON format for containerized applications, including creating environment variables, mounts, plugins, and other configuration details. It includes external dependencies such as jsoncpp, application configuration, and runtime management interfaces.

classes.name: DobbySpecGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating container runtime specifications in JSON format, including environment variables, mounts, plugins, and resource limits based on application configuration and runtime parameters.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates the runtime specification JSON string based on provided application and runtime configurations.

methods.name: createEnvVars
methods.description: Creates environment variables section for the container spec.

methods.name: createMounts
methods.description: Creates mount points section for the container spec.

methods.name: createAppServiceSDKPlugin
methods.description: Creates configuration for App Service SDK plugin.

methods.name: createBindMount
methods.description: Creates a bind mount configuration with source, destination, and options.

methods.name: shouldEnableGpu
methods.description: Determines if GPU should be enabled based on application configuration.

methods.name: getSysMemoryLimit
methods.description: Calculates system memory limit for the container.

methods.name: getGPUMemoryLimit
methods.description: Calculates GPU memory limit for the container.

methods.name: getVpuEnabled
methods.description: Checks if VPU (Video Processing Unit) is enabled.

methods.name: populateClassicPlugins
methods.description: Populates classic plugin configurations into the spec.

methods.name: createFkpsMounts
methods.description: Creates FKPS mounts in the spec.
